Yes, Barkers offers gift cards that arrive ready to give. You can choose a printed gift card, which is sent to any address you select, or a digital gift card, which is emailed directly to the recipient. Both options allow you to add a personalised message, and digital cards can be scheduled for later delivery.

Shipping times depend on your order:

NZ Post aims to deliver in 2 working days, but standard delivery is usually 1–3 working days within New Zealand, with rural addresses taking about 2 extra days. Orders must be placed before noon on weekdays, excluding public holidays.

For online purchases: Exchanges can be completed either online or in-store. To exchange online, use the returns courier label included with the parcel and fill out the Returns / Exchanges Form. For in-store exchanges, simply bring the item and proof of purchase to any Barkers store.

For in-store purchases: Bring the item and proof of purchase to any Barkers store. The team can assist with an exchange, store credit, or refund, depending on eligibility.
